name: How long does a house lifting project typically take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a house lifting project typically take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a house lifting project can vary significantly based on the project's complexity and the required scope of work. Generally, the entire process, including initial assessments, design, permit acquisition, the physical lift, new foundation construction, and settling the home, can range from several months to over a year. Key factors affecting duration include the home's size, the extent of new construction beneath the lifted structure, and local permitting department processing times in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. Our integrated design-build process is designed to provide scheduling transparency, ensuring homeowners are informed at every stage, aiming for efficient project completion while upholding our commitment to craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines for house lifting typically range from several months to over a year, depending on complexity, home size, new construction, and local permitting in the DFW area.
